title: A combinatorial interpolation between the hypercube and the associahedron
summary: We study a family of polytopes interpolating between the hypercube and the associahedron. We give an explicit description of their normal fans and describe their combinatorics in terms of chord diagrams associated to their vertices. This yields interesting number sequences generalizing Pell numbers and asymptotic to Catalan numbers. We describe the transition between the normal fans in terms of star subdivisions and relate them to polytopes associated to Dyck paths as in [Veronica Calvo Cortes and Hadleigh Frost.
